scope: Recheck of revised plan against previous findings and current target-resolution contracts; no spec or implementation edits.

findings.problem: Git-toplevel-first cwd selection skips an explicitly registered subdirectory and can implicitly approve a request for the parent workspace.
findings.fix: Preserve explicit registration precedence when resolving the containing target; use Git/worktree derivation without widening a registered subtree. Cover nested registrations, subdirectory-only registration, and derived-worktree descendants.

findings.problem: The summary and manual-fallback section still require both probes to be blocked, contradicting the authoritative matrix for A supported/B blocked.
findings.fix: Replace the duplicated condition with a reference to section 17.4: manual import ships when Probe B is blocked, regardless of Probe A.

findings.problem: Rollback wording promises unconditional protection from external edits, although a hash check followed by restore/unlink has the same check/use race documented for forward updates.
findings.fix: Apply the documented external-concurrency limitation to rollback as well; promise refusal on a detected mismatch rather than unconditional protection.

registeredSubdirectoryPrecedence.method: Initialize a disposable Git repository with a package child; register both roots; compare resolveLocalTarget(cwd) with resolveLocalTarget(gitToplevel).
registeredSubdirectoryPrecedence.cleanup: Temporary repository removed by shell EXIT trap.
registeredSubdirectoryPrecedence.limitation: Validates the existing resolver with inputs prescribed by the revised plan, not an implemented write CLI. Initial Node-child-process attempt hit spawnSync EPERM; shell-driven fixture completed successfully without escalation.

validation.capabilityConditions: Static comparison found two remaining contradictory conditions at lines 76 and 1632.
